environment: Android emulator; synthetic UART/SAF fixtures and real local adbd; physical OTG unavailable

tests.name: UI: USB panel without Accessibility or Docker
UI: dark theme and rotation
MCP: standalone foreground service, one listener and both agent tools
USB: empty bus, agent cannot mint leases or request permission
JNI: real x86 library loads, invalid physical descriptor fails cleanly
UART bridge: occupied port fails cleanly and listener can reopen
UART: binary loopback, shared cursors and exclusive protocol
UART: bounded log overflow and malformed inputs
ESP: native port rejects cancelled operation, restores UART lease
ESP: segment validation before any target write
SAF: selected tree, binary read/write and opaque handles
SAF: ownership, read-only grant, restore write and import SHA256
SAF: one-shot run grant expires, open streams and owned jobs revoked
SAF: provider read-only capability and unavailable-media status
SAF: unknown length import and partial provider write never succeeds
SAF: explicit document deletion and revoked tree
ADB AUTH: signature and Android RSA public-key encoding
ADB: corrupted legacy CNXN checksum is rejected
ADB: real emulator adbd shell_v2, stderr and nonzero exit
ADB: real sync push/pull binary SHA256 and shell isolation
ADB: actual APK install and target package verification
Jobs: other owner refused, cancellation is final
MCP: distinct run credentials and revoked authentication
Leases: one-shot next-run grant activates and expires (session fixture)
Docker MCP: another run cannot operate a task with assigned USB
Stop: blocks USB and Docker without Accessibility
